contents.text: The request comes back as a clear card, not a wall of text. Look at the booking card on the guesthouse's window, with the dates, the guests and the status. It says "Not sent yet" until someone agrees to send it.

choices.label: On to the next stop
choices.why: The agent asks before it sends

choices.label: Explain another section
choices.why: Pick any part of the page by its name

choices.label: Stop here
choices.why: We can pick it up any time
